newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediaset in screen product investment accord.
newsitem.headline: Mediaset in screen product investment accord.

text.p: Italian private broadcaster Mediaset, part of Silvio Berlusconi's media empire, will invest 240 billion lire in Italian and European screen products in 1997, it said in a statement.

The 240 billion is the amount stipulated for 1997 under a three-year self-regulation agreement with the association of televisual producers (APT) which envisages a fixed level of investment in Italian and European productions, the joint APT Mediaset statement said.
Under the agreement, 10 percent of Mediaset's net advertising revenues will be invested in production, co production and buying of new Italian and European screen works by independent producers.
Some 80 percent of the amount to be invested is reserved for narrative TV, fiction and film while the rest is for light entertainment and talkshows.
